title.zh: 本工具采用的节年规则

paragraphs.en: Before the displayed Beginning of Spring boundary, use the previous Gregorian year as the season year; clearly after it, use the entered year. The traditional anchor is 1927 = One White and 1928 = Nine Purple. The modular rule is ((1927 − season year) mod 9 + 9) mod 9 + 1. It labels the selected season; it does not determine when a birth happened.
paragraphs.zh: 在所示立春界点之前，采用上一公历年作为节年；明确在界点之后，采用输入年份。传统锚点为1927节年对应一白、1928节年对应九紫。模运算规则为((1927−节年) mod 9+9) mod 9+1。该规则为所选节年分配标签，不替你判断出生时刻。

title.en: A sourced boundary, displayed to a minute
title.zh: 有来源、显示到分钟的立春界点

paragraphs.en: The 1900–2026 boundaries are literal Beginning of Spring rows from the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan calculation service, using its current-theory 2.1i option, default ΔT and JST (UTC+09:00), with no daylight-saving correction. The stored values are displayed to a minute. They do not silently adopt the birth location’s time zone or replace the boundary with February 4 or Lunar New Year.
paragraphs.zh: 1900—2026年的界点来自日本国立天文台计算服务的立春原始行，采用其现代理论2.1i选项、默认ΔT与日本标准时JST（UTC+09:00），不加夏令时修正。保存的值显示到分钟，不暗中采用出生地时区，也不以固定2月4日或农历正月初一代替界点。

title.zh: 什么时候保留两个可能结果

paragraphs.en: If the birthday, birth time, time zone or comparison with JST is unknown, choose “Uncertain”. A birth within the displayed boundary minute is also uncertain. The result retains both the previous-season and current-season labels, with both complete guides. They are two conditional possibilities, without a probability, tie-break or preferred label.
paragraphs.zh: 生日、出生时刻、时区或与JST的换算不清楚时，请选“不确定”。出生在所显示的界点分钟内，也属于不确定。结果同时保留前一节年和当前节年的标签，并展示两篇完整指南。这是两个有条件的可能结果，不分配概率、不强行选一，也不推荐其中一个。

paragraphs.en: This is an annual cultural reference, without month, day, hour or third-star calculations, gender formulas, auspicious directions, compatibility, health or future predictions. Astronomy supplies the seasonal boundary; it does not validate personality claims. Only the year and boundary side enter this page’s memory. Editing invalidates the old result. Clearing, reloading, leaving or changing language removes the inputs; they are not stored as a draft or placed in a public URL. Copying shares only a public guide title and URL.
paragraphs.zh: 这里只提供年度文化参考，不计算月星、日星、时星或第三星，不使用性别公式，不推算吉方、配对、健康或未来。天文学提供季节界点，不验证人格主张。页面内存仅使用年份与界点前后；修改会清除旧结果，清除、刷新、离开或换语会移除输入。它们不保存为草稿，也不放入公开URL；复制仅包含公开指南标题和链接。

instructions.en: Enter a Gregorian year, then compare the birth moment with the displayed Beginning of Spring boundary in Japanese Standard Time (UTC+09:00). Select a side only if you can place that moment clearly before or after it; otherwise keep both possibilities. The displayed time is rounded to a minute, so a birth within that minute remains uncertain. This calculates one traditional year-star reference, not a complete birth chart or a measured personality.
instructions.zh: 输入公历年份，再将出生时刻与页面显示的立春界点比较。表中使用日本标准时（UTC+09:00），并非你的出生地时间。只有能够明确判断界点前后时才选单侧；生日、时刻或时区不清楚时保留两个可能结果。界点仅显示到分钟，出生在该分钟内也保留不确定。这只计算传统节年星参考，不是完整出生盘，也不是测得的人格。
